ELEMTDNT.description: Element Tendon Coordinates (ELEMTDNT). Returns the section tendon (strand) coordinates for an element at a given position along its length; fields are driven by the request DTO consumed in APIBusinessLogicHandlerELEMTDNT::OnPostWithBody.

Argument.description: Request arguments identifying the element and the position along it at which to extract tendon coordinates.

ELEM.description: Element number whose section tendon data is queried (used to look up T_ELEM_D via AttrCtrl.GetElem).

POS.description: Position ratio along the element length at which the section tendon coordinates are computed (dPos).
